body: I felt my stomach knotting as I noticed something unusual in the dimly lit parking lot—lights flickering on and off intermittently, like a ghostly presence lurking nearby. My mind raced back to the previous night when I had been so engrossed in our conversation that I couldn't recall much about the details of the building we were driving into. I shifted nervously in my seat, feeling an overwhelming urge to know more.
